Taxes 447,328 split from the General Fund schedule (property 276,121, sales 114,910, p11) and Street Fund schedule (sales 56,297, p12). Intergovernmental revenues 141,462 split from the same schedules (homestead, pro-rate, carline, property tax credit, highway allocation, incentive, motor vehicle fee). Bond issue costs 44,363 and interest paid 43,338 are printed under other financing sources; recorded as debt service disbursements with outside_printed_total. Ending cash = sum of all cash and certificate-of-deposit lines on the governmental funds balance sheet (p4).
